summary: Started planning a frontend and backend refactor for the Gizmo app. Inventoried the monorepo (apps/app, apps/agent-server, packages/design, packages/ui, packages/protocol, packages/extensions), gathered LOC counts for files ≥150 lines, and reviewed package/tsconfig/test configs to identify files exceeding the 200–300 LOC target. Spawned three background subagents (frontend audit, backend audit, test/config audit) to produce prioritized refactor phases with concrete paths.
decisions: Target file length cap: 200–300 LOC per file, set by the user as the refactor goal
Move tests out of src/ into per-workspace tests/ directories (currently 52 test files split between src and existing tests dirs, e.g. apps/agent-server/tests/ vs apps/agent-server/src/)

Extract reusable code into appropriate modules during the refactor (e.g. huge files flagged as candidates: packages/protocol/src/index.ts 1817 LOC, apps/app/src/lib/agent-client/AgentStore.svelte.ts 1335 LOC, apps/agent-server/src/sessions/pi-agent-service.ts 1278 LOC, apps/app/src/lib/agent-client/FakeAgentClient.ts 1262 LOC, apps/app/src/App.test.ts 999 LOC, apps/app/src/lib/agent-client/WebSocketAgentClient.ts 762 LOC)
Phase the refactor across frontend, backend, and test/config work via separate subagent audits to surface migration risks and import/config implications before any edits
Treat Svelte 5 conventions (runes, classes with $state, {@attach}, clsx-style class attrs) as binding guidance per the loaded svelte-core-bestpractices skill
errors: Bash heredoc Python LOC script failed with SyntaxError: unterminated string literal at line 10; switched to a PowerShell one-liner using Get-ChildItem/Get-Content, which then succeeded
